design_description: A dark, aggressive design built on a deep black base with vivid toxic pink graphics throughout. The front is dominated by an oversized distressed skull, surrounded by cracked, barbed-wire-like textures that spread organically across the torso and sleeves. The back keeps the same distressed language, with a huge hand-painted pink number, rough graffiti-style player name and a large biohazard symbol toward the lower hem. Bright pink detailing on the collar and cuffs ties into the graphics, while the mostly monochrome branding and crest maintain the toxic aesthetic. Overall, a rebellious Chicos Tóxicos identity combining punk/graffiti styling, skull imagery and hazardous-material symbolism into a deliberately raw football kit.
